sensei.title: Jonin-Sensei
sensei.interceptionHint: Passive reserve: can save a student from a fatal blow (Substitution, 25 chakra).

Egoiste.label: Selfish
Egoiste.bonus: Solitary pride: +2 Taijutsu/Ninjutsu when teammates have less HP.
Egoiste.malus: Defiant: ignores protect orders (will never be Tank).

Altruiste.label: Altruistic
Altruiste.bonus: Bodyguard: 50% chance to take a fatal blow for an ally.
Altruiste.malus: Sensitive: morale drops twice as fast after a defeat.

Faineant.label: Lazy
Faineant.bonus: Olympian calm: immune to the first Genjutsu of the match.

Temeraire.label: Reckless
Temeraire.malus: Raw consumption: +20% Chakra cost on techniques.

Discipline.label: Disciplined
Discipline.bonus: Total reliability: follows all orders to the letter.

bureau.title: Sensei Office
bureau.debtFreeze: Administrative freeze — repay your debt before any purchase, exam, or paid treatment.
bureau.trainingPlansHint: Pick one stat per ninja. Billed at H72 — no plan means no cost or gain.
bureau.budgetHint: Projection: active salaries, then opt-in training.
bureau.budgetOverdraftWarning: Some training may be cancelled (overdraft cap {limit} Ryos).
bureau.budgetDebtHint: Debt outstanding — interest charged at H72.
bureau.academyHint: One random aspirant each cycle — recruit or pass. Window H0–H12, 1 recruit max.

stagnation.title: Stagnation risk
stagnation.lead: At H72, form and morale drop if these ninjas stay stuck at their current grade.
stagnation.geninExam: ready for Chunin exam — register before H36
stagnation.chuninJonin: Chunin peak reached — register for the Vol d'Oiseau

birdFlight.title: Vol d'Oiseau
birdFlight.lead: Free registration before H72 · combat ≥ 16 and intelligence ≥ 14 · Ryos bonus and Genin replacement at cycle end.
birdFlight.stagnationWarning: Ready to graduate but not registered — form and morale will drop at H72.
birdFlight.graduationBody: {name} is now a Jonin. Bonus: +{ryos} Ryos, +{reputation} reputation.
birdFlight.arrivalBody: A new recruit joined the dojo: {name} ({profile}).

dispensary.title: Dispensary
dispensary.lead: Heal ninjas in Lamentable form: Lamentable → Passable before the next match.

chuninStagnation.title: Chunin at the peak
chuninStagnation.lead: Combat ≥ 16 and intelligence ≥ 14: the ninja is nearing graduation. Without Vol d'Oiseau, they stagnate.
chuninStagnation.warning: Form and morale will drop at H72 while they remain Chunin.

chuninExam.title: Chunin exams
chuninExam.lead: Register before H36 · combat ≥ 10 and intelligence ≥ 8 · results at mid-cycle.
chuninExam.closed: Registration closed this cycle — next window at H0.
chuninExam.stagnationWarning: Exam-ready but not registered — form and morale will drop at H72.

squad.lead: Manage your combat trio and bench before tactics lock.
squad.benchHint: Hover a card to bring it forward from the stack.
squad.swapPending: Pick the ninja to swap with.
squad.slotEmpty: Fill the open slot to complete your squad.
squad.tacticsLocked: Orders are locked for the Operation (from H71 onward).

league.lead: Six squads, ten cycles — climb the division or fall in the standings.
league.inviteLead: Share this link so a new player can join your pool (replaces a bot if a slot is open).

matches.noFixtures: No visible matches for this matchday.
matches.pickMatch: Select a match from the list.

operation.lead: Romanced chronicle of your weekly operation — revealed progressively at H71.
operation.leadBrowse: Watch your operation or other Sensei matches — your league or another pool.
operation.scheduled: Next opponent: {opponent}. The chronicle opens at H71.
operation.waiting: Waiting for the operation to begin or for the match simulation.

market.lead: Full catalogue — limited stock, cycle promos, full restock every 3 cycles.
market.debtBlocked: Administrative freeze — purchases suspended until debt is repaid.
market.consumableOnce: Single use — destroyed after the match
market.cycleItem: Active for the full cycle (72 h)

inventory.lead: Bureau items (use), match or cycle gear — one item per ninja.
inventory.empty: No items — visit the village shop.
inventory.sellHint: Price between {floor} and {ceiling} Ryos (50–200% of catalog)

exchanges.lead: Buy and sell items with Sensei in your league — window H0–H71.
exchanges.debtBlocked: Administrative freeze — purchases suspended until debt is repaid.
exchanges.noMyListings: No listings — list an item from inventory.
exchanges.empty: No listings in your league yet.

missions.title: Routine missions
missions.lead: Send bench ninjas on contracts (H0–H70) — locked until H72. Cost on send, payout if requirements met.
missions.debtHint: Debt outstanding: only free Rank D missions allowed.
